botania.page.elvenLore5a: 那时，我们的文明还没有形成完善的社会结构，人们居住在简单的梦之木小屋中。重建基本只需要收集材料，尤其是我们已经提前收到了警告。（At that time, we had little true structure to our civilization, living in simple huts of Dreamwood. This made rebuilding little more than a chore of gathering materials, especially as we had prior warning.）
